# Room 1, Seed Shelf: generated by make_env.py from its grid (do not edit by hand).
# A tiled bench (a violet and teal slate checker, white pads sunk in), violet planter-box walls under mint hedges (low where floor lies
# behind them, so the camera sees over), a violet skirt; bushes, flowers and pots on the walls.
# Up Z, the room's far row towards +Y; origin at the room's centre, the floor's top at z 0.
new
material new Tile --base-color 0.392 0.380 0.761 --no-slot
material new TileB --base-color 0.169 0.663 0.706 --no-slot
material new Pad --base-color 0.941 0.965 0.910 --no-slot
material new Planter --base-color 0.392 0.380 0.761 --no-slot
material new Hedge --base-color 0.576 0.831 0.710 --no-slot
material new Bench --base-color 0.392 0.380 0.761 --no-slot
material new Bush --base-color 0.169 0.663 0.706 --no-slot
material new Bloom --base-color 0.890 0.604 0.675 --no-slot
material new Pot --base-color 0.769 0.365 0.624 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Room --size 1 --x-subdivisions 6 --y-subdivisions 6 --location 0 0 0
scale 6 6 1
apply --scale
material assign Tile
mode edit
select mode face
select face where "(floor(pos.x + 20.25) + floor(pos.y + 20.25)) % 2 == 0"
material assign TileB
select face where "(abs(pos.x - -1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 1.50) < 0.3)"
inset 0.14
material assign Pad
select face where "(abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 1.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -1.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 1.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -1.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3)"
material assign Planter
select face where "(abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 1.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -1.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3)"
extrude 0 0 0.55
material assign Hedge
select face where "(abs(pos.x - -1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - -0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 0.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 1.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -2.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 1.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -0.50) < 0.3) || (abs(pos.x - 2.50) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - -1.50) < 0.3)"
extrude 0 0 0.3
material assign Hedge
select non-manifold
extrude --only-edges 0 0 -0.3
select face where "pos.z < -0.05"
material assign Bench
select face where "1"
normals recalculate
select face where "normal.x < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bush0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.34 --location -2.42 -0.38 0.63
scale 1 1 0.62
apply --scale
material assign Bush
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bloom0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location -2.34 -0.46 0.84
material assign Bloom
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bush1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.33 --location 2.47 -2.52 0.63
scale 1 1 0.62
apply --scale
material assign Bush
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bloom1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location 2.46 -2.60 0.83
material assign Bloom
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bush2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.27 --location -0.48 -2.58 0.38
scale 1 1 0.62
apply --scale
material assign Bush
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bloom2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location -0.57 -2.66 0.55
material assign Bloom
add mesh cone --name Pot3 --vertices 8 --radius1 0.15 --radius2 0.2 --depth 0.26 --location -2.46 2.61 0.68
material assign Pot
add mesh ico-sphere --name PotLeaf3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.24 --location -2.46 2.61 0.93
scale 1 1 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Bush
add mesh ico-sphere --name PotBloom3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.09 --location -2.38 2.51 1.07
material assign Bloom
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bush4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.29 --location -2.43 0.60 0.63
scale 1 1 0.62
apply --scale
material assign Bush
select all
shade flat
inspect stats
export room0.glb
